special_event_review.scope: Read-only supplement on ActionSweep exit-event routing, sticky-hit damage instances, push, and special activation. No formal/shared files or source files were changed.
special_event_review.verdict: Wrath's proc event is emitted by ActionSweep._handle_exit_procs as on_sweep_finish. Normal damage-window completion dispatches through either update or finish. Sticky sweeps suppress that normal dispatch and dispatch once from _stop_hit_stickyness when sticky ends (including when finish stops a still-sticky action). Individual sticky damage instances do not emit on_sweep_finish. Push emits on_push_finish; special activation only changes the active flag. A later completed, qualifying sweep can proc Wrath.

findings.conclusion: The actual buff proc-event producer is ActionSweep._handle_exit_procs, which packages num_hit_units and other sweep summary fields and sends on_sweep_finish once per invocation. WieldableSlotScripts.on_sweep_finish is a separate callback at ActionSweep.finish, not a buff proc event. A source search across weapon action scripts found no other add_proc_event producer for on_sweep_finish.

For a non-sticky sweep, the final damage-window update dispatches on_sweep_finish at the window exit; if finish occurs while the state is still during_damage_window, finish dispatches it instead. These are guarded alternative exit paths, and the damage-window state is advanced to after_damage_window.

Starting sticky hit sets is_sticky=true before its local not-currently-sticky check, so that start path does not emit on_sweep_finish. It exits the ordinary damage window while sticky processing continues.

Sticky update calls _stop_hit_stickyness after the sticky duration, target death timing, stealth, or dodge/jump exit condition. The stop helper emits on_sweep_finish before clearing is_sticky. If ActionSweep.finish finds the action still sticky, it invokes that helper and its captured is_sticky value suppresses the ordinary finish dispatch, preventing a duplicate event.

Sticky damage can execute multiple Attack.execute calls inside the per-frame damage-instance loop and can add a target-side buff_to_add_tick. That loop does not call _handle_exit_procs or emit on_sweep_finish. Wrath therefore receives a sweep-finish event at the sweep exit, not one event per sticky damage instance.
Push sends on_push_finish with its hit count, not on_sweep_finish. Push may also set the weapon-special-active flag, but that does not itself produce Wrath's sweep-finish event.

The manual activation, toggle, and overload-special actions set the weapon-special-active flag without emitting on_sweep_finish. A subsequent qualifying ActionSweep can still produce the event through the normal sweep exit path.

The shared Wrath parent listens to on_sweep_finish, requires num_hit_units > 0 for the active proc, and requires the trait item slot to be wielded. The event's hit count is the accumulated sweep hit-unit count, not the number of sticky damage instances.

producer_search.result: Only ActionSweep contains the actual buff add_proc_event(on_sweep_finish) call. The other on_sweep_finish match is the WieldableSlotScripts callback in ActionSweep.finish.
